originalCriterion: Build the pathway adapter so NGFS Phase VI can be swapped in when released.
finiteEngineeringCriterion: A versioned native-species CSV parser validates pinned provenance and schema, preserves raw/harmonized/infilled source stages, refuses malformed or incomplete selected-stage inputs, and accepts a separately profiled explicitly synthetic future-shaped dataset without changing parser logic.

implementation.trustedBoundary: ReleaseProfile is supplied by reviewed application/test code, not generated by trusting an uploaded CSV manifest. Manifest declarations must exactly match that profile, including types, with no extra fields; payload SHA256 must independently match its pinned artifact digest.
implementation.schema: ngfs-native-csv-v1; exact ordered Model,Scenario,Region,Variable,Unit identity columns followed by unique increasing reviewed year columns
validated: source version, source URL, schema version, release SHA256 and artifact SHA256
licence identifier, licence URL, attribution and restricted redistribution designation against reviewed profile
reviewed model, scenario and region; excluded IntegratedPhysicalDamages model variants
individual known native species; aggregate CO2-equivalent or unknown species refused
species-specific native mass unit; kt converted to Mt without CO2-equivalent inversion
published year schema, finite observations, nonnegative non-CO2 values and covered 2024-2100 horizon
duplicate stage/species rows, malformed CSV widths/encoding and missing selected-stage gases
implementation.stageSemantics: All three stages remain separate maps with source variable/unit, original published observations (including explicit null source cells) and annual native-Mt interpolation. No published stage is renamed or treated as an inventory adjustment. Missing species in any stage remain explicit. A missing required species in the requested stage is a hard refusal, never borrowed from another stage.
implementation.interpolation: Piecewise-linear interpolation only between finite published observations; no extrapolation; no invented missing species. Interpolated outputs also checked finite.
futureSwapProcedure: Obtain and review the actual future release independently; verify source provenance, licence, model/scenario definitions and native species/unit/schema compatibility.
Create a separately reviewed trusted ReleaseProfile with exact source/release and permitted artifact digests, allowed model/scenario/region and year schema.
Supply the matching manifest and exact bytes through adapt_versioned_csv. New schema or variable conventions require explicit review/code changes rather than fallback.
Keep accounting and scientific acceptance separate. This source parser does not generate an accepted production ensemble or an all-announced-commitments case.

inspectedExistingBoundaries.server/calculation/nativePathwayContract: Existing annual 2024-2100 full-native-inventory pair contract, baseline tolerance, signed CO2 handling and refusal to relabel NDC-only data as all announced commitments remain unchanged. The partial CH4 fixture is deliberately NOT submitted as a production pair.
inspectedExistingBoundaries.script/ngfs_pathway_adapter.py: Existing NGFS processing stage prefixes, native species/unit map and no-extrapolation interpolation reused by the new versioned parser. Existing diagnostic adjustment/reconcile function is not invoked by the new source parser.
inspectedExistingBoundaries.script/assess-ngfs.py: Existing Phase V archive pin, World extraction and source schema reviewed for fixture lineage.
inspectedExistingBoundaries.NGFSprocessing: No separate file or symbol named NGFSprocessing was found; the existing processing implementation inspected is script/ngfs_pathway_adapter.py.

actualPhaseVFixture.attribution: NGFS Phase V 5.1; REMIND-MAgPIE 3.3-4.8; IIASA scenario database
actualPhaseVFixture.redistributionDecision: Insubstantial attributed test extract: three CH4 rows only, 1124 bytes. Adapted NGFS licence is not ordinary CC BY 4.0. No substantial source portion, complete World extract, archive or workbook is added. This is a bounded repository fixture decision, not blanket production redistribution approval or legal advice.
actualPhaseVFixture.lineageVerification: Compared all three fixture dictionaries, including every year and blank cell, against matching rows of the existing local reviewed World extract: exact equality. Independently rehashed the existing local archive: matches the release pin. Neither large file was modified or copied into tracked paths.
actualPhaseVFixture.policyCutoffContext: March 2024 per existing NGFS compatibility assessment; this is a dated reference, not a new current forecast.

syntheticFutureFixture.construction: Wholly artificial N2O observations for 2020,2030,2100; separate raw, harmonized and infilled rows; changed model/scenario, source identity, release/artifact digest, licence and year profile.
syntheticFutureFixture.notEvidenceOf: An actual Phase VI release, actual Phase VI schema/content/licence verification, physical validity or production scientific acceptance

executions.scope: Six existing diagnostic adapter tests and six new versioned-boundary tests, with subtest matrices for refusals.

unchangedScope: No main ledger, commit, release, callback or Stage 14/FaIR changes
No changes to nativePathwayContract or live application source selection
No missing-gas infill, cross-stage borrowing, NDC/all-commitments substitution or invented fallback
